# Spectral Flow UMAP Creation

## Library Set Up

### GS vs GSRR

#### Tcell


```{r}
# ============================================================
# Install/load FlowSOM
# ============================================================

if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("BiocManager")
}

if (!requireNamespace("FlowSOM", quietly = TRUE)) {
  BiocManager::install("FlowSOM", ask = FALSE, update = FALSE)
}

library(FlowSOM)
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(uwot)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(FlowSOM)
library(pheatmap)
library(flowCore)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# T-cell spectral flow UMAP
# GS vs GSRR
# ============================================================

fcs_dir <- "/Data/Input/SpectralFlow_GSvsGSRR/Tcell"

# Find all FCS files
fcs_files <- list.files(
  fcs_dir,
  pattern = "\\.fcs$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

# Build sample metadata directly from filenames
sample_meta <- tibble(
  file = fcs_files,
  filename = basename(fcs_files)
) %>%
  mutate(
    group = case_when(
      str_detect(filename, "_GSRR_") ~ "GSRR",
      str_detect(filename, "_GS_")   ~ "GS",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    mouse = str_extract(filename, "(?<=_(GS|GSRR)_)[0-9]+")
  )

sample_meta
table(sample_meta$group)
```

```{r}
# Read one example FCS
test_fcs <- read.FCS(
  sample_meta$file[1],
  transformation = FALSE,
  truncate_max_range = FALSE
)

# Number of cells/events
nrow(exprs(test_fcs))

# Parameter/channel information
pData(parameters(test_fcs))[, c("name", "desc")]
```
```{r}
# ============================================================
# Import all gated CD3+ FCS files
# ============================================================

tcell_list <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(sample_meta)), function(i) {

  ff <- read.FCS(
    sample_meta$file[i],
    transformation = FALSE,
    truncate_max_range = FALSE
  )

  x <- as.data.frame(exprs(ff))

  # Add sample information
  x$filename <- sample_meta$filename[i]
  x$group    <- sample_meta$group[i]
  x$mouse    <- sample_meta$mouse[i]

  x
})

# Combine all mice into one dataframe
tcell_all <- bind_rows(tcell_list)

dim(tcell_all)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Check cell counts per mouse
# ============================================================

cell_counts <- tcell_all %>%
  count(group, mouse, filename, name = "n_cells") %>%
  arrange(group, mouse)

cell_counts
```
```{r}
cell_counts %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
  summarise(
    n_mice = n(),
    min_cells = min(n_cells),
    median_cells = median(n_cells),
    max_cells = max(n_cells),
    total_cells = sum(n_cells)
  )
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Create unique sample IDs
# ============================================================

tcell_all <- tcell_all %>%
  mutate(
    sample_id = paste0(group, "_", mouse)
  )

table(tcell_all$sample_id)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Rename compensated fluorescence channels
# ============================================================

tcell_all <- tcell_all %>%
  rename(
    PD1     = `FJComp-B510-A`,
    CD44    = `FJComp-B675-A`,
    CTLA4   = `FJComp-B710-A`,
    CD3     = `FJComp-R675-A`,
    CD45    = `FJComp-R780-A`,
    LD      = `FJComp-UV379-A`,
    CD4     = `FJComp-UV660-A`,
    CD62L   = `FJComp-V427-A`,
    KI67    = `FJComp-V510-A`,
    CD8     = `FJComp-V595-A`,
    NK11    = `FJComp-V660-A`,
    CD19    = `FJComp-V710-A`,
    CD69    = `FJComp-V785-A`,
    MCHERRY = `FJComp-YG585-A`,
    FOXP3   = `FJComp-YG780-A`
  )

colnames(tcell_all)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Remove CD4- CD8- NK1.1- cells
# Exploratory cutoff = 0
#
# Keep:
# CD4+ OR CD8+ OR NK1.1+
# ============================================================

filter_check_gs <- tcell_all %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    keep_cell = CD4 > 0 | CD8 > 0 | NK11 > 0
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(group, sample_id) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    total_cells = dplyr::n(),
    retained_cells = sum(keep_cell),
    removed_cells = sum(!keep_cell),
    percent_removed = removed_cells / total_cells * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

filter_check_gs

# Remove triple-negative cells
tcell_all <- tcell_all %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    CD4 > 0 |
    CD8 > 0 |
    NK11 > 0
  )

# Remaining cells per mouse
tcell_all %>%
  dplyr::count(
    group,
    sample_id,
    name = "n_cells"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(n_cells)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Define T/NK-cell UMAP markers
# ============================================================

tcell_markers <- c(
  "CD4",
  "CD8",
  "FOXP3",
  "PD1",
  "CTLA4",
  "CD44",
  "CD62L",
  "KI67",
  "CD69",
  "NK11",
  "CD3"
)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Arcsinh transformation
# ============================================================

cofactor <- 150

tcell_all <- tcell_all %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      all_of(tcell_markers),
      ~ asinh(.x / cofactor),
      .names = "{.col}_asinh"
    )
  )

tcell_markers_asinh <- paste0(
  tcell_markers,
  "_asinh"
)

summary(
  tcell_all[, tcell_markers_asinh]
)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Balanced downsampling for T-cell UMAP
# 600 cells per mouse
# ============================================================

set.seed(123)

n_per_mouse <- 1000

# Confirm every mouse has enough cells
stopifnot(
  min(table(tcell_all$sample_id)) >= n_per_mouse
)

tcell_umap_df <- tcell_all %>%
  group_by(
    group,
    sample_id
  ) %>%
  slice_sample(
    n = n_per_mouse
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Verify equal cells per mouse
tcell_umap_df %>%
  count(
    group,
    sample_id,
    name = "n_cells"
  )

# Verify equal total representation per condition
tcell_umap_df %>%
  count(
    group,
    name = "total_cells"
  )
```
```{r}
# ============================================================
# Combined GS + GSRR T-cell UMAP
# ============================================================

set.seed(123)

tcell_umap_input <- tcell_umap_df %>%
  select(all_of(tcell_markers_asinh)) %>%
  as.matrix()

tcell_umap <- uwot::umap(
  tcell_umap_input,
  n_neighbors = 20,
  min_dist = 0.4,
  metric = "euclidean",
  n_components = 2,
  verbose = TRUE
)

tcell_umap_df$UMAP1 <- tcell_umap[, 1]
tcell_umap_df$UMAP2 <- tcell_umap[, 2]
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# T-cell feature UMAP function
# ============================================================

feature_plot_gs <- function(df, marker) {

  marker_col <- paste0(marker, "_asinh")

  limits <- quantile(
    df[[marker_col]],
    probs = c(0.01, 0.99),
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  # High-expression cells plotted on top
  plot_df <- df %>%
    arrange(.data[[marker_col]])

  ggplot(
    plot_df,
    aes(
      x = UMAP1,
      y = UMAP2,
      color = .data[[marker_col]]
    )
  ) +
    geom_point(
      size = 0.25,
      alpha = 0.8
    ) +
    scale_color_viridis_c(
      option = "plasma",
      limits = limits,
      oob = scales::squish
    ) +
    coord_equal() +
    theme_classic() +
    labs(
      title = marker,
      x = "UMAP1",
      y = "UMAP2",
      color = "Arcsinh\nexpression"
    )
}
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
```
```{r}
# FlowSOM clustering
# GS vs GSRR T cells
# ============================================================

set.seed(123)

flowsom_input_gs <- tcell_umap_df %>%
  select(all_of(tcell_markers_asinh)) %>%
  as.matrix()

fsom_gs <- FlowSOM::FlowSOM(
  flowsom_input_gs,
  compensate = FALSE,
  transform = FALSE,
  scale = FALSE,
  colsToUse = colnames(flowsom_input_gs),
  xdim = 15,
  ydim = 15,
  nClus = 10,
  seed = 123
)

# Add cluster assignments
tcell_umap_df$cluster <- factor(
  FlowSOM::GetMetaclusters(fsom_gs)
)

# Check cluster sizes
table(tcell_umap_df$cluster)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
```
```{r}
# SAVE FINAL GS vs GSRR T-CELL ANALYSIS
# After unwanted cluster removal + final 1/2 merge
# ============================================================

out_dir <- "/Data/Output/GSvsGSRR/Tcell"

if (!dir.exists(out_dir)) {
  dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE)
}


# ============================================================
# Final cluster order
# ============================================================

merged_levels <- c(
  "1_2",
  "3",
  "4",
  "5",
  "6",
  "7",
  "8",
  "9",
  "10"
)

tcell_umap_no1 <- tcell_umap_no1 %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    cluster_merged = factor(
      cluster_merged,
      levels = merged_levels
    )
  )


# ============================================================
# Randomize plotting order
# Prevent one cluster systematically plotting on top
# ============================================================

set.seed(123)

tcell_umap_no1_plot <- tcell_umap_no1 %>%
  dplyr::slice_sample(prop = 1)


# ============================================================
# 1. FINAL merged-cluster UMAP
# ============================================================

p_final_umap <- ggplot(
  tcell_umap_no1_plot,
  aes(
    x = UMAP1,
    y = UMAP2,
    color = cluster_merged
  )
) +
  geom_point(
    size = 0.22,
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = cluster_colors_merged,
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  coord_equal() +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    title = "T-cell UMAP",
    x = "UMAP1",
    y = "UMAP2",
    color = "Cluster"
  )

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    out_dir,
    "Tcell_FINAL_MergedCluster_UMAP.pdf"
  ),
  plot = p_final_umap,
  width = 6,
  height = 5
)


# ============================================================
# 2. FINAL merged-cluster phenotype heatmap
# ============================================================

pheatmap::pheatmap(
  tcell_cluster_heatmap_merged,
  scale = "column",
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  main = "T-cell merged cluster phenotypes",
  filename = file.path(
    out_dir,
    "Tcell_FINAL_MergedCluster_Heatmap.pdf"
  ),
  width = 7,
  height = 5
)


# ============================================================
# 3. FINAL GS vs GSRR split UMAP
# Same shared UMAP coordinates
# ============================================================

p_split_umap <- ggplot(
  tcell_umap_no1_plot,
  aes(
    x = UMAP1,
    y = UMAP2,
    color = cluster_merged
  )
) +
  geom_point(
    size = 0.22,
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = cluster_colors_merged,
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ group
  ) +
  coord_equal() +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    title = "GS vs GSRR T-cell UMAP",
    x = "UMAP1",
    y = "UMAP2",
    color = "Cluster"
  )

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    out_dir,
    "Tcell_FINAL_GS_vs_GSRR_Split_UMAP.pdf"
  ),
  plot = p_split_umap,
  width = 10,
  height = 5
)


# ============================================================
# 4. Save final merged-cluster median expression
# ============================================================

write.csv(
  tcell_cluster_medians_merged,
  file.path(
    out_dir,
    "Tcell_FINAL_MergedCluster_MedianExpression.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


# ============================================================
# 5. Save final per-cell UMAP + cluster assignments
# ============================================================

tcell_final_assignments <- tcell_umap_no1 %>%
  dplyr::select(
    group,
    sample_id,
    UMAP1,
    UMAP2,
    cluster,
    cluster_merged
  )

write.csv(
  tcell_final_assignments,
  file.path(
    out_dir,
    "Tcell_FINAL_UMAP_ClusterAssignments.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


# ============================================================

list.files(

)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Myeloid spectral flow UMAP
# GS vs GSRR
# Starting population: CD11B+
# ============================================================

fcs_dir <- "/Data/Input/SpectralFlow_GSvsGSRR/Myeloid"

# Find all FCS files
fcs_files <- list.files(
  fcs_dir,
  pattern = "\\.fcs$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

# Build sample metadata from filenames
sample_meta <- tibble(
  file = fcs_files,
  filename = basename(fcs_files)
) %>%
  mutate(
    group = case_when(
      str_detect(filename, "_GSRR_") ~ "GSRR",
      str_detect(filename, "_GS_")   ~ "GS",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    mouse = str_match(
      filename,
      "_(?:GS|GSRR)_([0-9]+)_"
    )[, 2]
  )

sample_meta
table(sample_meta$group)
```
```{r}
# ============================================================
# Import all gated CD11B+ FCS files
# ============================================================

myeloid_list <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(sample_meta)), function(i) {

  ff <- read.FCS(
    sample_meta$file[i],
    transformation = FALSE,
    truncate_max_range = FALSE
  )

  x <- as.data.frame(exprs(ff))

  x$filename <- sample_meta$filename[i]
  x$group    <- sample_meta$group[i]
  x$mouse    <- sample_meta$mouse[i]

  x
})

myeloid_all <- bind_rows(myeloid_list)

dim(myeloid_all)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Myeloid feature UMAP plotting function
# ============================================================

feature_plot_myeloid <- function(df, marker) {

  marker_col <- paste0(marker, "_asinh")

  # Clip visualization at 1st and 99th percentiles
  limits <- quantile(
    df[[marker_col]],
    probs = c(0.01, 0.99),
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  # Plot low-expression cells first,
  # so high-expression cells remain visible on top
  plot_df <- df %>%
    arrange(.data[[marker_col]])

  ggplot(
    plot_df,
    aes(
      x = UMAP1,
      y = UMAP2,
      color = .data[[marker_col]]
    )
  ) +
    geom_point(
      size = 0.25,
      alpha = 0.8
    ) +
    scale_color_viridis_c(
      option = "plasma",
      limits = limits,
      oob = scales::squish
    ) +
    coord_equal() +
    theme_classic() +
    labs(
      title = marker,
      x = "UMAP1",
      y = "UMAP2",
      color = "Expression"
    )
}
```

### COL vs COLKO

#### Tcell

```{r}
# ============================================================
# T-cell spectral flow UMAP
# COL KO vs Ctrl
# ============================================================

fcs_dir <- "/Data/Input/SpectralFlow_COLvsCOLKO/Tcell"

# Find all FCS files
fcs_files <- list.files(
  fcs_dir,
  pattern = "\\.fcs$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

# Build metadata from filenames
sample_meta_col <- tibble(
  file = fcs_files,
  filename = basename(fcs_files)
) %>%
  mutate(
    group = case_when(
      str_detect(filename, "COL_KO") ~ "COL_KO",
      str_detect(filename, "_Ctrl_") ~ "Ctrl",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    mouse = str_match(
      filename,
      "_([0-9]{3})_CD3"
    )[, 2],
    sample_id = paste0(group, "_", mouse)
  )

sample_meta_col

table(sample_meta_col$group)

# Make sure every file parsed correctly
stopifnot(!any(is.na(sample_meta_col$group)))
stopifnot(!any(is.na(sample_meta_col$mouse)))
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Import all gated CD3+ FCS files
# ============================================================

tcell_col_list <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(sample_meta_col)), function(i) {

  ff <- read.FCS(
    sample_meta_col$file[i],
    transformation = FALSE,
    truncate_max_range = FALSE
  )

  x <- as.data.frame(exprs(ff))

  x$filename  <- sample_meta_col$filename[i]
  x$group     <- sample_meta_col$group[i]
  x$mouse     <- sample_meta_col$mouse[i]
  x$sample_id <- sample_meta_col$sample_id[i]

  x
})

tcell_col_all <- bind_rows(tcell_col_list)

dim(tcell_col_all)
table(tcell_col_all$group)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
```
```{r}
# Remove CD4- CD8- NK1.1- cells
# Exploratory cutoff = 0
#
# Keep:
# CD4+ OR CD8+ OR NK1.1+
# ============================================================

filter_check_col <- tcell_col_all %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    keep_cell = CD4 > 0 | CD8 > 0 | NK11 > 0
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(group, sample_id) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    total_cells = dplyr::n(),
    retained_cells = sum(keep_cell),
    removed_cells = sum(!keep_cell),
    percent_removed = removed_cells / total_cells * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

filter_check_col

# Actually remove triple-negative cells
tcell_col_all <- tcell_col_all %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    CD4 > 0 |
    CD8 > 0 |
    NK11 > 0
  )

# Check remaining cells per mouse
tcell_col_all %>%
  dplyr::count(
    group,
    sample_id,
    name = "n_cells"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(n_cells)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Arcsinh transformation
# ============================================================

cofactor <- 150

tcell_col_all <- tcell_col_all %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      all_of(col_tcell_markers),
      ~ asinh(.x / cofactor),
      .names = "{.col}_asinh"
    )
  )

col_tcell_markers_asinh <- paste0(
  col_tcell_markers,
  "_asinh"
)

summary(tcell_col_all[, col_tcell_markers_asinh])
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Feature UMAP function
# ============================================================

feature_plot_col <- function(df, marker) {

  marker_col <- paste0(marker, "_asinh")

  limits <- quantile(
    df[[marker_col]],
    probs = c(0.01, 0.99),
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  plot_df <- df %>%
    arrange(.data[[marker_col]])

  ggplot(
    plot_df,
    aes(
      x = UMAP1,
      y = UMAP2,
      color = .data[[marker_col]]
    )
  ) +
    geom_point(
      size = 0.25,
      alpha = 0.8
    ) +
    scale_color_viridis_c(
      option = "plasma",
      limits = limits,
      oob = scales::squish
    ) +
    coord_equal() +
    theme_classic() +
    labs(
      title = marker,
      x = "UMAP1",
      y = "UMAP2",
      color = "Expression"
    )
}
```

```{r}
    cluster,
    fill = list(n_cells = 0)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    group,
    sample_id
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    total_cells = sum(n_cells),
    percent_cluster = (n_cells / total_cells) * 100
  ) %>%

    mean_percent = mean(
      percent_cluster,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    sd_percent = sd(
      percent_cluster,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    sem_percent = sd_percent / sqrt(n),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Myeloid spectral flow UMAP
# COL vs Ctrl
# Starting population: CD11B+
# ============================================================

fcs_dir <- "/Data/Input/SpectralFlow_COLvsCOLKO/Myeloid"

# Find all FCS files
fcs_files_myeloid_col <- list.files(
  fcs_dir,
  pattern = "\\.fcs$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

# Build metadata from filenames
sample_meta_myeloid_col <- tibble(
  file = fcs_files_myeloid_col,
  filename = basename(fcs_files_myeloid_col)
) %>%
  mutate(
    group = case_when(
      str_detect(filename, "_COL_")  ~ "COL",
      str_detect(filename, "_Ctrl_") ~ "Ctrl",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    
    mouse = str_match(
      filename,
      "_([0-9]{3})_"
    )[, 2],
    
    sample_id = paste0(group, "_", mouse)
  )

sample_meta_myeloid_col

table(sample_meta_myeloid_col$group)

stopifnot(!any(is.na(sample_meta_myeloid_col$group)))
stopifnot(!any(is.na(sample_meta_myeloid_col$mouse)))
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Import all gated CD11B+ FCS files
# ============================================================

myeloid_col_list <- lapply(
  seq_len(nrow(sample_meta_myeloid_col)),
  function(i) {

    ff <- read.FCS(
      sample_meta_myeloid_col$file[i],
      transformation = FALSE,
      truncate_max_range = FALSE
    )

    x <- as.data.frame(exprs(ff))

    x$filename  <- sample_meta_myeloid_col$filename[i]
    x$group     <- sample_meta_myeloid_col$group[i]
    x$mouse     <- sample_meta_myeloid_col$mouse[i]
    x$sample_id <- sample_meta_myeloid_col$sample_id[i]

    x
  }
)

myeloid_col_all <- bind_rows(myeloid_col_list)

dim(myeloid_col_all)
table(myeloid_col_all$group)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Myeloid feature UMAP function
# ============================================================

feature_plot_myeloid_col <- function(df, marker) {

  marker_col <- paste0(marker, "_asinh")

  limits <- quantile(
    df[[marker_col]],
    probs = c(0.01, 0.99),
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  # Plot high-expression cells on top
  plot_df <- df %>%
    arrange(.data[[marker_col]])

  ggplot(
    plot_df,
    aes(
      x = UMAP1,
      y = UMAP2,
      color = .data[[marker_col]]
    )
  ) +
    geom_point(
      size = 0.25,
      alpha = 0.8
    ) +
    scale_color_viridis_c(
      option = "plasma",
      limits = limits,
      oob = scales::squish
    ) +
    coord_equal() +
    theme_classic() +
    labs(
      title = marker,
      x = "UMAP1",
      y = "UMAP2",
      color = "Arcsinh\nexpression"
    )
}
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
```
```{r}
# Sample metadata
# ============================================================

sample_meta <- tibble(
  file = fcs_files,
  filename = basename(fcs_files)
) %>%
  mutate(
    group = case_when(
      str_detect(filename, "_BKM_")  ~ "BKM",
      str_detect(filename, "_Ctrl_") ~ "Ctrl",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    mouse = str_match(filename, "_(\\d{3})_")[, 2],

    sample_id = paste0(group, "_", mouse)
  )

sample_meta
```
```{r}
# ============================================================
# Import all gated T-cell FCS files
# ============================================================

tcell_list <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(sample_meta)), function(i) {

  ff <- read.FCS(
    sample_meta$file[i],
    transformation = FALSE,
    truncate_max_range = FALSE
  )

  x <- as.data.frame(exprs(ff))

  x$filename  <- sample_meta$filename[i]
  x$group     <- sample_meta$group[i]
  x$mouse     <- sample_meta$mouse[i]
  x$sample_id <- sample_meta$sample_id[i]

  x
})

tcell_all <- bind_rows(tcell_list)

dim(tcell_all)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Remove CD4- CD8- NK1.1- cells
# Exploratory cutoff = 0
#
# Keep cells that are:
# CD4+ OR CD8+ OR NK1.1+
# ============================================================

filter_check <- tcell_all %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    keep_cell = CD4 > 0 | CD8 > 0 | NK11 > 0
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(group, sample_id) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    total_cells = dplyr::n(),
    retained_cells = sum(keep_cell),
    removed_cells = sum(!keep_cell),
    percent_removed = removed_cells / total_cells * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

filter_check

# Actually remove triple-negative cells
tcell_all <- tcell_all %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    CD4 > 0 |
    CD8 > 0 |
    NK11 > 0
  )

# Check remaining cells per mouse
tcell_all %>%
  dplyr::count(
    group,
    sample_id,
    name = "n_cells"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(n_cells)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Feature UMAP function
# ============================================================

feature_plot_bkm <- function(df, marker) {

  marker_col <- paste0(marker, "_asinh")

  limits <- quantile(
    df[[marker_col]],
    probs = c(0.01, 0.99),
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  plot_df <- df %>%
    arrange(.data[[marker_col]])

  ggplot(
    plot_df,
    aes(
      x = UMAP1,
      y = UMAP2,
      color = .data[[marker_col]]
    )
  ) +
    geom_point(
      size = 0.25,
      alpha = 0.8
    ) +
    scale_color_viridis_c(
      option = "plasma",
      limits = limits,
      oob = scales::squish
    ) +
    coord_equal() +
    theme_classic() +
    labs(
      title = marker,
      x = "UMAP1",
      y = "UMAP2",
      color = "Expression"
    )
}
```

```{r}
      na.rm = TRUE

    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Mean expression heatmap
# BKM120 vs Ctrl T cells
# Min-max scaled 0–1 PER MARKER
#
# 0 = lowest mean-expressing cluster for that marker
# 1 = highest mean-expressing cluster for that marker
# ============================================================

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Calculate actual mean arcsinh expression by cluster
# ------------------------------------------------------------

bkm_cluster_means_01 <- tcell_bkm_umap_df %>%
  dplyr::group_by(cluster) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    dplyr::across(
      dplyr::all_of(bkm_tcell_markers_asinh),
      mean,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Rescale EACH MARKER from 0 to 1 across clusters
# ------------------------------------------------------------

bkm_cluster_means_scaled01 <- bkm_cluster_means_01 %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    dplyr::across(
      dplyr::all_of(bkm_tcell_markers_asinh),
      ~ {
        marker_min <- min(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
        marker_max <- max(.x, na.rm = TRUE)

        if (marker_max == marker_min) {
          rep(0, length(.x))
        } else {
          (.x - marker_min) / (marker_max - marker_min)
        }
      }
    )
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Prepare heatmap matrix
# ------------------------------------------------------------

bkm_cluster_heatmap_scaled01 <- bkm_cluster_means_scaled01 %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("cluster") %>%
  as.matrix()

colnames(bkm_cluster_heatmap_scaled01) <- stringr::str_remove(
  colnames(bkm_cluster_heatmap_scaled01),
  "_asinh$"
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Plot
# IMPORTANT: scale = "none"
# Values are ALREADY scaled 0–1 above
# ------------------------------------------------------------

pheatmap::pheatmap(
  bkm_cluster_heatmap_scaled01,
  scale = "none",
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  breaks = seq(0, 1, length.out = 101),
  main = "BKM120 T-cell Cluster Phenotypes — Relative Mean Expression"
)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# BIOCONDUCTOR-STYLE PHENOTYPE HEATMAP
# BKM120 vs Ctrl T cells
#
# Workflow:
# 1. Start with cell-level arcsinh-transformed expression
# 2. For EACH marker:
#       1st percentile  -> 0
#       99th percentile -> 1
# 3. Values below 1st percentile clipped to 0
# 4. Values above 99th percentile clipped to 1
# 5. Calculate MEDIAN scaled expression within each cluster
# 6. Plot directly — NO additional pheatmap scaling
# ============================================================


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Make a separate dataframe for heatmap visualization
# Does NOT modify tcell_bkm_umap_df
# ------------------------------------------------------------

bkm_bioc_heatmap_df <- tcell_bkm_umap_df


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Scale EACH marker at the CELL LEVEL
# using its 1st and 99th percentiles
# ------------------------------------------------------------

for (marker_i in bkm_tcell_markers_asinh) {

  # Marker-specific percentile limits
  q01 <- stats::quantile(
    bkm_bioc_heatmap_df[[marker_i]],
    probs = 0.01,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  q99 <- stats::quantile(
    bkm_bioc_heatmap_df[[marker_i]],
    probs = 0.99,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  # Rescale 1st percentile -> 0
  #         99th percentile -> 1
  scaled_values <- (
    bkm_bioc_heatmap_df[[marker_i]] - q01
  ) / (
    q99 - q01
  )

  # Clip values outside percentile range
  scaled_values[scaled_values < 0] <- 0
  scaled_values[scaled_values > 1] <- 1

  # Save as NEW column
  bkm_bioc_heatmap_df[[paste0(marker_i, "_01")]] <- scaled_values
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Names of the new 0-1 transformed marker columns
# ------------------------------------------------------------

bkm_bioc_markers_01 <- paste0(
  bkm_tcell_markers_asinh,
  "_01"
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Calculate MEDIAN 0-1 expression within each cluster
# ------------------------------------------------------------

bkm_bioc_cluster_medians <- bkm_bioc_heatmap_df %>%
  dplyr::group_by(cluster) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    dplyr::across(
      dplyr::all_of(bkm_bioc_markers_01),
      median,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Prepare heatmap matrix
# ------------------------------------------------------------

bkm_bioc_cluster_heatmap <- bkm_bioc_cluster_medians %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("cluster") %>%
  as.matrix()

# Clean marker labels
colnames(bkm_bioc_cluster_heatmap) <- colnames(
  bkm_bioc_cluster_heatmap
) %>%
  stringr::str_remove("_asinh_01$")


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Plot Bioconductor-style heatmap
#
# IMPORTANT:
# scale = "none"
# because we already transformed the CELL-LEVEL data to 0-1
# ------------------------------------------------------------

bioc_heatmap_colors <- grDevices::colorRampPalette(
  rev(
    RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(
      n = 9,
      name = "RdYlBu"
    )
  )
)(100)

pheatmap::pheatmap(
  bkm_bioc_cluster_heatmap,
  scale = "none",
  color = bioc_heatmap_colors,
  breaks = seq(
    0,
    1,
    length.out = 101
  ),
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  main = "BKM120 T-cell Cluster Phenotypes"
)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# RECOVER BKM120 T-cell analysis
# STEP 1 — locate files + rebuild metadata
# SAFE: does not run UMAP, FlowSOM, or save anything
# ============================================================

bkm_recover_dir <- "/Data/Input/SpectralFlow_BKM120/T cell"

bkm_recover_files <- list.files(
  bkm_recover_dir,
  pattern = "\\.fcs$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

bkm_recover_meta <- tibble::tibble(
  file = bkm_recover_files,
  filename = basename(bkm_recover_files)
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    group = dplyr::case_when(
      stringr::str_detect(filename, "_BKM_")  ~ "BKM",
      stringr::str_detect(filename, "_Ctrl_") ~ "Ctrl",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    mouse = stringr::str_match(
      filename,
      "_(\\d{3})_"
    )[, 2],
    sample_id = paste0(group, "_", mouse)
  )

bkm_recover_meta

table(
  bkm_recover_meta$group,
  useNA = "ifany"
)

stopifnot(!any(is.na(bkm_recover_meta$group)))
stopifnot(!any(is.na(bkm_recover_meta$mouse)))
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# RECOVER BKM120 T-cell analysis
# STEP 2 — import FCS files
# SAFE: creates new bkm_recover_* objects only
# ============================================================

bkm_recover_list <- lapply(
  seq_len(nrow(bkm_recover_meta)),
  function(i) {

    ff <- flowCore::read.FCS(
      bkm_recover_meta$file[i],
      transformation = FALSE,
      truncate_max_range = FALSE
    )

    x <- as.data.frame(
      flowCore::exprs(ff)
    )

    x$filename  <- bkm_recover_meta$filename[i]
    x$group     <- bkm_recover_meta$group[i]
    x$mouse     <- bkm_recover_meta$mouse[i]
    x$sample_id <- bkm_recover_meta$sample_id[i]

    x
  }
)

bkm_recover_all <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  bkm_recover_list
)

# Check dimensions
dim(bkm_recover_all)

# Check cells per mouse
bkm_recover_cell_counts <- bkm_recover_all %>%
  dplyr::count(
    group,
    mouse,
    sample_id,
    filename,
    name = "n_cells"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    group,
    mouse
  )

bkm_recover_cell_counts
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# RECOVER BKM120 T-cell analysis
# STEP 4 — arcsinh transform + balanced downsampling
# SAFE: recovery objects only
# ============================================================

bkm_recover_markers <- c(
  "CD4",
  "CD8",
  "FOXP3",
  "PD1",
  "CTLA4",
  "CD44",
  "CD62L",
  "KI67",
  "CD69",
  "NK11",
  "CD3"
)

bkm_recover_cofactor <- 150

bkm_recover_all <- bkm_recover_all %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    dplyr::across(
      dplyr::all_of(bkm_recover_markers),
      ~ asinh(.x / bkm_recover_cofactor),
      .names = "{.col}_asinh"
    )
  )

bkm_recover_markers_asinh <- paste0(
  bkm_recover_markers,
  "_asinh"
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Same balanced downsampling as original analysis
# ------------------------------------------------------------

set.seed(123)

bkm_recover_n_per_mouse <- 1000

stopifnot(
  min(table(bkm_recover_all$sample_id)) >= bkm_recover_n_per_mouse
)

bkm_recover_ds <- bkm_recover_all %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    group,
    sample_id
  ) %>%
  dplyr::slice_sample(
    n = bkm_recover_n_per_mouse
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

# Verify
bkm_recover_ds %>%
  dplyr::count(
    group,
    sample_id,
    name = "n_cells"
  )

bkm_recover_ds %>%
  dplyr::count(
    group,
    name = "total_cells"
  )
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Per-mouse T-cell cluster proportions
# BKM120 vs Ctrl
# SAFE: no UMAP involved
# ============================================================

bkm_recover_cluster_levels <- as.character(1:8)

tcell_bkm_cluster_prop <- bkm_recover_final %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    cluster = factor(
      cluster,
      levels = bkm_recover_cluster_levels
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::count(
    group,
    sample_id,
    cluster,
    name = "n_cells"
  ) %>%
  tidyr::complete(
    tidyr::nesting(group, sample_id),
    cluster,
    fill = list(n_cells = 0)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    group,
    sample_id
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    proportion = n_cells / sum(n_cells)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

# Verify structure
table(
  tcell_bkm_cluster_prop$cluster,
  useNA = "ifany"
)

table(
  tcell_bkm_cluster_prop$group,
  useNA = "ifany"
)
```

```{r}
  x$sample_id <- sample_meta_myeloid$sample_id[i]
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Myeloid feature UMAP function
# ============================================================

feature_plot_myeloid <- function(df, marker) {

  marker_col <- paste0(marker, "_asinh")

  limits <- quantile(
    df[[marker_col]],
    probs = c(0.01, 0.99),
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  plot_df <- df %>%
    arrange(.data[[marker_col]])

  ggplot(
    plot_df,
    aes(
      x = UMAP1,
      y = UMAP2,
      color = .data[[marker_col]]
    )
  ) +
    geom_point(
      size = 0.15,
      alpha = 0.8
    ) +
    scale_color_viridis_c(
      option = "plasma",
      limits = limits,
      oob = scales::squish
    ) +
    coord_equal() +
    theme_classic() +
    labs(
      title = marker,
      x = "UMAP1",
      y = "UMAP2",
      color = "Expression"
    )
}
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Identify SOM nodes belonging to FlowSOM cluster 1
# ============================================================

# SOM codebook vectors
som_codes <- as.matrix(
  fsom_myeloid_bkm$map$codes
)

# Metacluster assignment for each SOM node
som_metaclusters <- fsom_myeloid_bkm$metaclustering

# Which SOM nodes belong to cluster 1?
cluster1_nodes <- which(
  som_metaclusters == 1
)

length(cluster1_nodes)

# Sanity check
dim(som_codes)
length(som_metaclusters)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Subcluster ONLY the SOM nodes within cluster 1
# ============================================================

cluster1_codes <- som_codes[
  cluster1_nodes,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

# Hierarchical clustering of cluster-1 SOM nodes
cluster1_hc <- stats::hclust(
  stats::dist(cluster1_codes),
  method = "ward.D2"
)

# Start with 4 local subclusters
cluster1_node_subclusters <- stats::cutree(
  cluster1_hc,
  k = 4
)

table(cluster1_node_subclusters)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Map cluster-1 subclusters back to individual cells
# ============================================================

# Create lookup for ALL SOM nodes
node_subcluster_lookup <- rep(
  NA_integer_,
  nrow(som_codes)
)

# Fill only the nodes belonging to original cluster 1
node_subcluster_lookup[
  cluster1_nodes
] <- cluster1_node_subclusters


# SOM node assigned to every individual cell
cell_som_node <- fsom_myeloid_bkm$map$mapping[, 1]


# Add local cluster-1 subcluster assignment
myeloid_bkm_umap_df <- myeloid_bkm_umap_df %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    cluster1_subcluster = ifelse(
      cluster == "1",
      node_subcluster_lookup[cell_som_node],
      NA
    )
  )

table(
  myeloid_bkm_umap_df$cluster1_subcluster,
  useNA = "ifany"
)
```

### Myeloid Validated Gates

#### GS vs GSRR

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Input files + sample metadata
# Validated-gate myeloid populations
# ============================================================

validated_myeloid_dir <- "/Data/Input/SpectralFlow_GSvsGSRR/Myeloid_Validatedgates"

validated_myeloid_files <- list.files(
  validated_myeloid_dir,
  pattern = "\\.fcs$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

validated_sample_meta <- data.frame(
  file = validated_myeloid_files,
  filename = basename(validated_myeloid_files),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    group = dplyr::case_when(
      grepl("Ope_GSRR_[0-9]{3}", filename) ~ "GSRR",
      grepl("Ope_GS_[0-9]{3}", filename)   ~ "GS",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    mouse = stringr::str_match(
      filename,
      "Ope_(?:GS|GSRR)_([0-9]{3})"
    )[, 2],

    sample_id = paste0(group, "_", mouse)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(group, mouse)

validated_sample_meta

table(validated_sample_meta$group)

stopifnot(
  nrow(validated_sample_meta) == 14,
  !any(is.na(validated_sample_meta$group)),
  !any(is.na(validated_sample_meta$mouse)),
  !anyDuplicated(validated_sample_meta$sample_id)
)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Import all validated-gate myeloid FCS files
# ============================================================

validated_myeloid_list <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(validated_sample_meta)), function(i) {

  ff <- flowCore::read.FCS(
    validated_sample_meta$file[i],
    transformation = FALSE,
    truncate_max_range = FALSE
  )

  x <- as.data.frame(flowCore::exprs(ff))

  x$filename  <- validated_sample_meta$filename[i]
  x$group     <- validated_sample_meta$group[i]
  x$mouse     <- validated_sample_meta$mouse[i]
  x$sample_id <- validated_sample_meta$sample_id[i]

  x
})

validated_myeloid_all <- dplyr::bind_rows(validated_myeloid_list)

dim(validated_myeloid_all)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Arcsinh transformation
# Exclude CD45 and MCHERRY — already handled by gating
# ============================================================

validated_myeloid_markers <- c(
  "LY6C",
  "CD172",
  "XCR1",
  "CD317",
  "CD11B",
  "CD206",
  "CCR2",
  "LY6G",
  "F480",
  "MHCII",
  "CD86",
  "CD11C"
)

validated_myeloid_all <- validated_myeloid_all %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    dplyr::across(
      dplyr::all_of(validated_myeloid_markers),
      ~ asinh(.x / 150),
      .names = "{.col}_asinh"
    )
  )
```


```{r}
# ============================================================
# Downsample to maximum 5,000 cells per mouse
# ============================================================

set.seed(123)

validated_myeloid_ds <- validated_myeloid_all %>%
  dplyr::group_by(sample_id) %>%
  dplyr::group_modify(
    ~ dplyr::slice_sample(
      .x,
      n = min(5000, nrow(.x))
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

# Check final cell counts per mouse
validated_myeloid_ds %>%
  dplyr::count(group, mouse, sample_id, name = "n_cells") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(group, mouse)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Run reproducible UMAP on validated-gate myeloid cells
# ============================================================

validated_umap_markers <- paste0(
  validated_myeloid_markers,
  "_asinh"
)

validated_umap_input <- validated_myeloid_ds %>%
  dplyr::select(
    dplyr::all_of(validated_umap_markers)
  ) %>%
  as.matrix()

set.seed(123)

validated_umap <- uwot::umap(
  validated_umap_input,
  n_neighbors = 30,
  min_dist = 0.6,
  metric = "euclidean",

  # Reproducibility
  seed = 123,
  n_sgd_threads = 1,
  n_threads = 1,

  verbose = TRUE
)

validated_myeloid_umap_df <- validated_myeloid_ds %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    UMAP1 = validated_umap[, 1],
    UMAP2 = validated_umap[, 2]
  )
```

#### COL vs COLKO

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Input files + sample metadata
# Validated-gate myeloid — Ctrl vs COL KO
# ============================================================

validated_col_myeloid_dir <- "/Data/Input/SpectralFlow_COLvsCOLKO/Myeloid_ValidatedGates"

validated_col_myeloid_files <- list.files(
  validated_col_myeloid_dir,
  pattern = "\\.fcs$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

validated_col_sample_meta <- data.frame(
  file = validated_col_myeloid_files,
  filename = basename(validated_col_myeloid_files),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    group = dplyr::case_when(
      grepl("_COL_[0-9]{3}", filename, ignore.case = TRUE)  ~ "COLKO",
      grepl("_Ctrl_[0-9]{3}", filename, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Ctrl",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    mouse = stringr::str_match(
      filename,
      "(?:COL|Ctrl)_([0-9]{3})"
    )[, 2],

    sample_id = paste0(group, "_", mouse)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(group, mouse)

validated_col_sample_meta

table(validated_col_sample_meta$group)

stopifnot(
  !any(is.na(validated_col_sample_meta$group)),
  !any(is.na(validated_col_sample_meta$mouse)),
  !anyDuplicated(validated_col_sample_meta$sample_id)
)
```
```{r}
# ============================================================
# Import all validated-gate myeloid FCS files
# Ctrl vs COL KO
# ============================================================

validated_col_myeloid_list <- lapply(
  seq_len(nrow(validated_col_sample_meta)),
  function(i) {

    ff <- flowCore::read.FCS(
      validated_col_sample_meta$file[i],
      transformation = FALSE,
      truncate_max_range = FALSE
    )

    x <- as.data.frame(
      flowCore::exprs(ff)
    )

    x$filename  <- validated_col_sample_meta$filename[i]
    x$group     <- validated_col_sample_meta$group[i]
    x$mouse     <- validated_col_sample_meta$mouse[i]
    x$sample_id <- validated_col_sample_meta$sample_id[i]

    x
  }
)

validated_col_myeloid_all <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  validated_col_myeloid_list
)

dim(validated_col_myeloid_all)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Downsample to maximum 5,000 cells per mouse

validated_col_myeloid_ds <- validated_col_myeloid_all %>%

  dplyr::group_modify(
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Run UMAP — validated-gate myeloid
# Ctrl vs COL KO
# ============================================================

validated_col_umap_markers <- paste0(
  validated_col_myeloid_markers,
  "_asinh"
)

validated_col_umap_input <- validated_col_myeloid_ds %>%
  dplyr::select(
    dplyr::all_of(validated_col_umap_markers)
  ) %>%
  as.matrix()

set.seed(123)

validated_col_umap <- uwot::umap(
  validated_col_umap_input,
  n_neighbors = 30,
  min_dist = 0.6,
  metric = "euclidean",
  n_threads = 1,
  n_sgd_threads = 1,
  verbose = TRUE
)

validated_col_myeloid_umap_df <- validated_col_myeloid_ds %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    UMAP1 = validated_col_umap[, 1],
    UMAP2 = validated_col_umap[, 2]
  )
```

```{r}
    labs(

      color = "Expression",
      x = "UMAP1",
      y = "UMAP2"
    ) +
    theme(
      axis.text = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks = element_blank()
    )

  validated_col_feature_plots[[marker]] <- p

  print(p)
}
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Input files + sample metadata
# Validated-gate myeloid — BKM120 vs Ctrl
# ============================================================

validated_bkm_myeloid_dir <- "/Data/Input/SpectralFlow_BKM120/Myeloid_ValidatedGates"

validated_bkm_myeloid_files <- list.files(
  validated_bkm_myeloid_dir,
  pattern = "\\.fcs$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

validated_bkm_sample_meta <- data.frame(
  file = validated_bkm_myeloid_files,
  filename = basename(validated_bkm_myeloid_files),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    group = dplyr::case_when(
      grepl("_BKM_[0-9]{3}", filename, ignore.case = TRUE)  ~ "BKM",
      grepl("_ctrl_[0-9]{3}", filename, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Ctrl",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    mouse = stringr::str_match(
      filename,
      "(?:BKM|ctrl)_([0-9]{3})"
    )[, 2],

    sample_id = paste0(group, "_", mouse)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(group, mouse)

validated_bkm_sample_meta

table(validated_bkm_sample_meta$group)

stopifnot(
  !any(is.na(validated_bkm_sample_meta$group)),
  !any(is.na(validated_bkm_sample_meta$mouse)),
  !anyDuplicated(validated_bkm_sample_meta$sample_id)
)
```
```{r}
# ============================================================
# Import all validated-gate myeloid FCS files
# BKM120 vs Ctrl
# ============================================================

validated_bkm_myeloid_list <- lapply(
  seq_len(nrow(validated_bkm_sample_meta)),
  function(i) {

    ff <- flowCore::read.FCS(
      validated_bkm_sample_meta$file[i],
      transformation = FALSE,
      truncate_max_range = FALSE
    )

    x <- as.data.frame(
      flowCore::exprs(ff)
    )

    x$filename  <- validated_bkm_sample_meta$filename[i]
    x$group     <- validated_bkm_sample_meta$group[i]
    x$mouse     <- validated_bkm_sample_meta$mouse[i]
    x$sample_id <- validated_bkm_sample_meta$sample_id[i]

    x
  }
)

validated_bkm_myeloid_all <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  validated_bkm_myeloid_list
)

dim(validated_bkm_myeloid_all)
```

```{r}
    MHCII   = `FJComp-V710-A`,
    CD86    = `FJComp-V785-A`,
    MCHERRY = `FJComp-YG585-A`,
    CD11C   = `FJComp-YG780-A`
  )

colnames(validated_bkm_myeloid_all)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Arcsinh transformation
# Exclude CD45 and MCHERRY — already handled by gating
# ============================================================

validated_bkm_myeloid_markers <- c(
  "LY6C",
  "CD172",
  "XCR1",
  "CD317",
  "CD11B",
  "CD206",
  "CCR2",
  "LY6G",
  "F480",
  "MHCII",
  "CD86",
  "CD11C"
)

validated_bkm_myeloid_all <- validated_bkm_myeloid_all %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    dplyr::across(
      dplyr::all_of(validated_bkm_myeloid_markers),
      ~ asinh(.x / 150),
      .names = "{.col}_asinh"
    )
  )
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Downsample to maximum 2,000 cells per mouse
# BKM120 vs Ctrl
# ============================================================

set.seed(123)

validated_bkm_myeloid_ds <- validated_bkm_myeloid_all %>%
  dplyr::group_by(sample_id) %>%
  dplyr::group_modify(
    ~ dplyr::slice_sample(
      .x,
      n = min(2000, nrow(.x))
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

# Check final cell counts per mouse
validated_bkm_myeloid_ds %>%
  dplyr::count(
    group,
    mouse,
    sample_id,
    name = "n_cells"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(group, mouse)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Run UMAP — validated-gate myeloid
# BKM120 vs Ctrl
# ============================================================

validated_bkm_umap_markers <- paste0(
  validated_bkm_myeloid_markers,
  "_asinh"
)

validated_bkm_umap_input <- validated_bkm_myeloid_ds %>%
  dplyr::select(
    dplyr::all_of(validated_bkm_umap_markers)
  ) %>%
  as.matrix()

set.seed(123)

validated_bkm_umap <- uwot::umap(
  validated_bkm_umap_input,
  n_neighbors = 30,
  min_dist = 0.6,
  metric = "euclidean",
  n_threads = 1,
  n_sgd_threads = 1,
  verbose = TRUE
)

validated_bkm_myeloid_umap_df <- validated_bkm_myeloid_ds %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    UMAP1 = validated_bkm_umap[, 1],
    UMAP2 = validated_bkm_umap[, 2]
  )

dim(validated_bkm_myeloid_umap_df)
```
```{r}
# ============================================================
# Feature UMAPs — validated-gate myeloid markers
# BKM120 vs Ctrl
# ============================================================

validated_bkm_feature_plots <- list()

for (marker in validated_bkm_myeloid_markers) {

  marker_asinh <- paste0(marker, "_asinh")

  p <- ggplot(
    validated_bkm_myeloid_umap_df,
    aes(
      x = UMAP1,
      y = UMAP2,
      color = .data[[marker_asinh]]
    )
  ) +
    geom_point(
      size = 0.35,
      alpha = 0.8
    ) +
    scale_color_viridis_c(
      option = "plasma"
    ) +
    coord_fixed() +
    theme_classic() +
    labs(
      title = marker,
      color = "Expression",
      x = "UMAP1",
      y = "UMAP2"
    ) +
    theme(
      axis.text = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks = element_blank()
    )

  validated_bkm_feature_plots[[marker]] <- p

  print(p)
}
```
